name: Hermes Secure Email Gateway Community Edition
free_limit: Free self-hosted Community Edition mail security gateway and mail server with spam and malware filtering, encryption, mailboxes, archiving and administration; no software usage quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Bring your own Linux/Docker host, storage, DNS, static IP and TLS certificates; recommended minimum 4 vCPUs, 8 GB RAM and 120 GB OS/config disk. Pro-only features require a paid license. AGPLv3 obligations apply to covered Community code; external mail services and infrastructure may cost money.
